ns2:course.label: Music in Early Childhood
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 349) Detailed consideration of the music program in nursery schools, kindergarten, and the primary grades; topics include the nature of early musical responses, objectives, experience levels of the program, methods of teaching, and materials. Observation of music teaching at the Child Development Laboratory is included in the course work. Same as HDFS 449. Prerequisite: Senior or graduate standing in music, or consent of instructor.
